rules.notes: CPU capabilities are exposed through Python/pybind11; no duplicate CPU MEX parity is promised.

gpu_features.scope: FP64 CSR Jacobi-preconditioned CG; caller assembles the system. This does not certify AMS, ICCG or HDiv-MMM.
Experimental real FP64 lowest-order HCurl AMS cycles 1/7; MATLAB-owned native setup and CUDA application/PCG. Not ICCG or HDiv-MMM certification.
gpu_features.cpu_reference: Python/pybind11 shared HypreBasedAMS, independent solve and true-residual validation

gpu_features.scope: Experimental affine tetrahedral lowest-order HCurl assembly and positive-gauge nonlinear solve; explicit homogeneous coefficients
gpu_features.cpu_reference: Independent Python NGSolve FE assembly and Newton solve

gpu_features.scope: Experimental fixed affine lowest-order linear HCurl matrix/hierarchy reuse with explicit source-current scaling; recreate for geometry, labels or coefficient changes
gpu_features.cpu_reference: Independent Python NGSolve sparsecholesky linear solution and operator true residual; nonlinear candidate independently checked with NGSolve Newton/AMS

gpu_features.scope: Experimental real FP64 natural-order fixed-shift IC(0)-PCG and affine linear HCurl matrix/factor reuse; explicit free-mask constraints. A100 formal performance pending.
gpu_features.cpu_reference: Independent Python NGSolve sparsecholesky/IC and NumPy original-equation references; CPU execution remains Python only

gpu_features.scope: Experimental numeric Laplace scalar/dipole FMM, weighted Biot-Savart, retained field clouds and flat exterior P1 SL/DL boundary operators; speed acceptance pending
gpu_features.cpu_reference: NumPy direct sum, analytic sphere/current and independent NGSolve Galerkin BEM

gpu_features.scope: Bounded affine/P2 tetrahedral HDiv orders 1/2, linear isotropic material; device-built operators and resident FP64 solve over a checked device setup. General adaptive geometry, interfaces and constraints remain unsupported.
gpu_features.cpu_reference: Independent Python/pybind11 NGSolve charge map, mass, sparsecholesky and original-equation true residual

gpu_features.scope: Experimental device-built Gram, charge map, evaluation map and reference mass with the shared GPU BH frozen-tangent Newton, for affine tet, curved P2 tet and hex HDiv orders 1/2 over a radia.hdiv-device-setup.v1. No matrix crosses from the host. No mixed/pyramid claim.
gpu_features.cpu_reference: radia.vim.Solve and the CPU material on identical checked meshes; Gram, operator, mass and linear solve of the assembled CPU equation in the curved and hex device lanes

same_kernel_bitwise_parity.input_contract: One canonical HDF5 of NGSolve device-construction tables, inverse-BH payload, vectors and solver controls; same input SHA256.
same_kernel_bitwise_parity.compiler_contract: Same source SHA, CUDA compiler version, device architecture and device UUID; --fmad=false --ftz=false --prec-div=true --prec-sqrt=true; no fast math; record full compile commands.
same_kernel_bitwise_parity.acceptance: Exact dtype, shape and bytes for each declared output; no tolerance or CPU/GPU-oracle substitution.
same_kernel_bitwise_parity.execution: Requires a separately admitted Windows GPU run of the pybind11 module and plain MEX linked from one nvcc object; not executed by source contracts or Flow2 Linux smoke.

legacy_matlab_sources: Historical sources remain under their integration owner but are not claims of supported CPU MEX or included wholesale in the GPU wheel.
